assessment.summary: The code, URLs, numbers and structure are all intact, and several idioms are rebuilt well for German readers. No issue is a blocker (severity ≥4), but I'm marking it not ready because of three medium problems that are cheap to fix. First, the text switches from du to Sie after the intro and stays formal for most of the body, which undercuts Dan's direct voice and makes the article look patched together. Second, 'Routenpräzision' is the wrong ML term for route accuracy. Third, one sentence in the experiments section is ungrammatical. Smaller polish items: 'Eingabeaufforderung' (means command prompt), 'die ganze Narbe', 'raten über', the lost Evils/Evals pun, and frontmatter date/popularity that need confirming.

assessment.summary: Solid, largely idiomatic German with all code, identifiers, numbers, URLs and MDX intact. Blocking issue: the text addresses the reader as 'du' through the introduction and then switches to 'Sie' for the remaining ~80%, which German readers register immediately as a defect and which flattens Dan's voice into vendor register. Three medium fixes: unify 'Routengenauigkeit' (not 'Routenpräzision', a different metric), repair the garbled startExperiment sentence, and replace 'Routing-Eingabeaufforderung' with 'Routing-Prompt'. Several minor polish items follow.

findings.quote: Wenn der Router nur eine finale Antwort liefert, raten Sie über die eigentliche Entscheidung.
findings.sourceQuote: If the router only produces a final answer, you are guessing about the decision.
findings.claim: Register switch. The introduction and inset use du ('Schick nicht jede Aufgabe', 'Sobald du einen Router hinzufügst', 'dein System'). From this sentence onward every section uses Sie ('Geben Sie', 'Beginnen Sie', 'Halten Sie die Achsen getrennt', 'Bewerten Sie die Entscheidung'). Mixing formal and informal address within one article is a hard error in German writing, not a preference, and the Sie register is the sanitized vendor tone the brief excludes. Pervasive across roughly 40 sentences.
findings.suggestion: Convert the body to du consistently, matching the introduction and the subtitle ('Leite Anfragen ...'). E.g. 'rätst du über die eigentliche Entscheidung', 'Gib dem Routing-Schritt', 'Halte die Achsen getrennt', 'Bewerte die Entscheidung. Bewerte den Weg. Bewerte die Antwort.'

findings.quote: Der alte Router erzielte eine Routenpräzision von `0.94`.
findings.sourceQuote: The old router scored `0.94` on route accuracy.
findings.claim: Terminology drift and technical slip. The first half uses 'Routengenauigkeit' for route accuracy; from the experiment section on it becomes 'Routenpräzision' (also in the heading 'Was nach der Routenpräzision zu messen ist' and 'Die Routenpräzision kann es normalerweise nicht feststellen'). Precision and accuracy are distinct evaluation metrics; the scorer described is a plain match rate, i.e. accuracy.
findings.suggestion: Use 'Routengenauigkeit' throughout, including the section heading.

findings.quote: Mit dem Dataset [`dataset.startExperiment()`](https://mastra.ai/reference/datasets/startExperiment) können Sie es gegen einen registrierten Agenten, Workflow oder Scorer ausführen.
findings.sourceQuote: With the dataset in place, [`dataset.startExperiment()`](https://mastra.ai/reference/datasets/startExperiment) runs it against a registered agent, workflow, or scorer.
findings.claim: Garbled sentence. 'Mit dem Dataset' directly followed by the method link reads as if the method were the dataset's name, and 'es' has no clear antecedent. The source's 'in place' condition is lost.
findings.suggestion: 'Sobald das Dataset steht, führt [`dataset.startExperiment()`](...) es gegen einen registrierten Agenten, Workflow oder Scorer aus.'

findings.quote: Die erste Routing-Eingabeaufforderung besteht normalerweise aus einem Absatz voller Abwägungen.

findings.suggestion: 'Der erste Routing-Prompt besteht normalerweise aus einem Absatz voller Ermessensentscheidungen.'
